title: Nine rejected modeling constructions
interpretation: Each snippet is appended independently to the positive source. A rejection must include the expected diagnostic; successful compilation of the shared positive source is checked separately.

probes.name: equality_cannot_be_forged
probes.expected_diagnostic_contains: member chain produces result of type 'TypeEquality<String, String>' but contextual base was inferred as 'TypeEquality<String, Bool>'

probes.name: gadt_wrong_result
probes.expected_diagnostic_contains: cannot convert value of type 'TypeEquality<Bool, Bool>' to expected argument type 'TypeEquality<String, Bool>'

probes.name: associated_family_wrong_node
probes.expected_diagnostic_contains: cannot convert value of type 'FlagSyntax' to expected argument type 'TextSyntax'

probes.name: associated_family_wrong_mapping
probes.snippet: enum BadSort: ExpressionSort { typealias Value = Int; typealias Syntax = TextSyntax }
probes.expected_diagnostic_contains: type 'BadSort' does not conform to protocol 'ExpressionSort'

probes.name: pack_wrong_input_types
probes.expected_diagnostic_contains: cannot convert value of type 'String' to expected argument type 'Int'

probes.name: pack_wrong_arity
probes.expected_diagnostic_contains: missing argument for parameter #1 in call

probes.name: pack_wrong_output_types
probes.snippet: let impossible: HList<Int, Int, Bool> = transformations.apply(42, "Swift", false)
probes.expected_diagnostic_contains: cannot assign value of type 'HList<String, Int, Bool>' to type 'HList<Int, Int, Bool>'

probes.name: positional_evidence_wrong_list
probes.expected_diagnostic_contains: cannot convert value of type 'HCons<Int, HCons<String, HNil>>' to expected argument type 'HCons<Int, HNil>'

probes.name: private_equality_constructor
probes.snippet: let impossible = TypeEquality<String, Bool>(forward: { _ in true }, backward: { _ in "x" })
probes.expected_diagnostic_contains: 'TypeEquality<A, B>' initializer is inaccessible due to 'private' protection level
